reply.answer_text: After the settlor dies, a trustee surrender is taxed at 25% net with no top-slicing. The better route is to appoint segments out to each adult beneficiary first, then they surrender using their own personal rates and top-slicing – often far lower tax. When appointing out, you must check for an IHT exit charge based on complete quarters since the last 10-year anniversary. Both routes require all trustees to sign with verified ID and current trust documentation.
